verified_against.production_run: 20260929T130736Z-e6d03314e704 (2026-02-01 .. 2026-09-29, 1305 items, 17908 accepted status events, 861 completed first cycles, 681 attributed to a mapped Editor, contract 1.5.0)

classes.reliable: present for (nearly) every record and defined by an approved rule; may be used directly
classes.usable_with_limitations: present or derivable but partial, lower-bound or proxy; every use must carry the stated limitation
classes.unavailable: not captured by the current Monday ingest; no detector may depend on it
classes.unsafe_to_infer: a value could be guessed from other data, but an approved rule or the data itself forbids it; no detector may depend on it

project_id.source: Monday item ID (pulse_id) on every activity log and item snapshot

limitations: one board only; no cross-board analysis is possible

status_event_id.source: activity log id of each accepted status transition (normalized event_id)
limitations: duplicate event IDs are de-duplicated by normalization

status_history.source: accepted NormalizedStatusEvents per item (from, to, occurred_at)
status_history.coverage: every item with status activity; 1300 of 1305 items have proven complete history (create_pulse read)
limitations: 804 status logs are quarantined as UNKNOWN_STATUS (retired statuses, D18) and 231 as STATUS_CLEARED; a time span containing an unknown status cannot be assigned to a stage
history before 2026-02-01 is outside the ingest window

editor_execution_interval.source: cycles: first In Progress -> first Ready For Approval (D2, D3)
limitations: elapsed clock time, not effort; nights, weekends and parallel work are included (D3)

editor_identity.source: Editor Name value in effect at Ready For Approval, resolved by (source_label_id, logged_name) (D48-D51)
limitations: 180 completed cycles have no verified Editor (MISSING_EDITOR_EVENT, EDITOR_CHANGED_WITHIN_CYCLE, quarantined identities); they can enter team-level stage timing but never an Editor finding
open cycles are not attributed: the Editor is resolved at Ready For Approval

current_editor_of_open_work.source: current item snapshot of Editor Name (profile._current_editor)
limitations: current fact only; never used for past work

editor_assignment_time.source: Editor Name column-change event (or create_pulse value) that set the value in effect at Ready For Approval
editor_assignment_time.coverage: cycles whose Editor value was logged inside the ingest window
limitations: the time the value was set, not when the Editor saw the work
a reassignment to the same Editor is indistinguishable from the first
missing for items created before 2026-02-01

video_type.source: latest valid Video Type at or before Ready For Approval (D8), exact cohort key; benchmark-eligible per D14
video_type.coverage: every attributed completed cycle has a cohort key; 'Unbranded' (26) and 'Reels Boost Pack' (22) cohorts are not benchmark-eligible
limitations: the only available complexity control; video length, footage and brief are not captured

requested_eta.source: latest valid Requested ETA at or before first Ready For Approval (D19); history of every observed value
requested_eta.coverage: 646 of 681 attributed completed cycles have a timed ETA; 32 date-only, 3 missing
limitations: a date-only ETA is never given a time (D6)
in 58 cycles the selected ETA was first observed after In Progress (the ETA was set or changed during the work)

requested_eta_at_work_start.source: latest valid Requested ETA observed at or before first In Progress, from the same history
requested_eta_at_work_start.coverage: cycles whose ETA history reaches back before In Progress
limitations: not a metric input under D19; context for runway only

execution_runway.source: selected Requested ETA - first In Progress
limitations: uses the ETA in effect at first Ready For Approval; when that ETA was first observed after In Progress the runway is flagged eta_observed_after_work_start

performance_labels.source: Performance Issues and For Bonus columns, current item value, per-label registry (D26-D30)
performance_labels.coverage: 366 attributed occurrences; 149 occurrences quarantined (no completed cycle or unresolved Editor)
limitations: applied by hand: rates are lower bounds (only a minority of computed-late projects carry Late Delivery)
a removed label does not count
labels sit on a project, attributed to the Editor of its first completed cycle

label_timestamp.source: activity log that added the label
limitations: never moves a project to another window (D42)
context only; never Editor fault
context only; no cause inferred
no reason field is captured; only client vs internal is known (D31)

stage_durations.source: consecutive accepted status events of one item (dwell = next entry - this entry)
stage_durations.coverage: items without a quarantined status inside the measured span
limitations: elapsed time; the last visit of an item is right-censored at retrieval and excluded
a span that contains a quarantined (unknown) status is not assigned to any stage

post_editor_delivery.source: first transition into a delivered-phase status (Sent, Done) after first Ready For Approval
limitations: who moved the card is not identifiable for most transitions (shared account)
a role, never a person; unlisted transitions stay unresolved
the shared account is used by several people; it never identifies a person (AGENTS.md, SPEC.md)
Activity-log user_id is audit metadata only (rule 3); no mapping of accounts to roles is approved

concurrent_workload_history.source: overlap of the same Editor's attributed completed first-cycle intervals
limitations: lower bound: open, unattributed, rework and non-first cycles are not counted
concurrency is not effort; no capacity rule is approved (D33, HANDOFF §21)

current_open_work.source: current item snapshot: Status and Editor Name (D33 Active Work / Awaiting Approval)
limitations: current state only; the time an open project entered its current status comes from the status history
no reviewer column is ingested; review performance is out of scope (HANDOFF §27)
not captured; client intelligence is out of scope (HANDOFF §39)
video length, footage volume and brief quality are not captured
Monday records status changes, not time worked
no priority field; why a project waited is a hypothesis only
free text that may name clients; not used by any rule and not reproduced in findings

retired_status_meaning.source: quarantined labels such as Uploading, Editing Now, Ready For Review
limitations: meaning not attested (D18); affected spans are excluded
